scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @splash/server" "npm run dev -w @splash/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @splash/client && npm run build -w @splash/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @splash/shared && npm run typecheck -w @splash/server && npm run typecheck -w @splash/client
